method: Best of seven interleaved process wall times, including startup and I/O; every output checked; two-second timeout.

scope.roster: 19 C++ evaluators with both GCC and Clang, six assembly, three JavaScript, three WebAssembly, one Python.
scope.cpp_build_note: Local driver omits the include and registry entry for LazyAppStream, which is not in the official suite, because append_range is unavailable. Evaluator sources are unchanged. Upstream normally uses Clang/libc++/C++23.
scope.broad_scan_note: Candidate before final bulk initialization of initial machine arrays; includes previous native baseline.
scope.final_head_to_head_note: Final binary against all six assembly evaluators and five fastest C++ configurations selected from broad scan, plus previous native baseline. All outputs passed.
scope.limitations: Results apply to this machine and workloads. Tiny size workload is startup-sensitive. Failed competitors are recorded as failures, not valid timings.

validation.includes: Independent Python oracle, both reduction backends, malformed inputs, deep stack/buffer growth, upstream programs at additional sizes.
